items.title: Billkin Served Looks At Gucci's Spring/Summer 2026 Launch At Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Regional SEA coverage of Thai actor and Gucci ambassador Billkin Putthipong visiting Gucci's newly renovated Marina Bay Sands boutique in Singapore hours after the SS26 collection debuted in Milan; the two-floor, 10,555 sq ft store (the only SEA location carrying the full new line) was redesigned with warm-toned wood, horse murals and dimmer lighting. Fans gathered outside the store for his appearance.

items.title: Gucci's New Campaign Gets It: Asian Stars Rule Fashion Now
items.summary: Philippine fashion outlet analysis of the Primavera campaign framing the five Asian talents (Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, Tarzzan) as proof Asian celebrity power now drives global luxury attention rather than being a novelty; SEA-published commentary though the cast itself skews East Asian rather than Southeast Asian talent.

items.title: Gucci Sparks Backlash After Using AI Models For Milan Fashion Week Campaign
items.summary: Critical-angle coverage of backlash Gucci faced over AI-generated promotional imagery ahead of Demna's Milan Fashion Week show, with critics calling the visuals "AI slop" and questioning why a house charging up to $10,000 for a bag would rely on synthetic imagery instead of real models; one widely-shared comment mocked the brand for not finding "a real human Milanese grandmother." Asia-regional syndication of an ongoing reputational thread relevant to SEA consumers tracking the Primavera rollout.

items.title: Kering Revenues Declined 6.2% in Q1, with Gucci Still Sluggish
items.summary: Trade financial coverage confirming Kering group revenue fell 6.2% in Q1 2026 with Gucci down 14.3%, part of a broader pattern that saw Kering close roughly 84 stores in H1 2026 (about 40% of 2025's net closures being Gucci locations); critical-angle macro context relevant to SEA store-network and investment decisions even though the report itself is global in scope.

items.title: BTS Member Gets Brutally Trolled Over New Look (Jin's Gucci Primavera styling)
items.summary: Fan-community aggregation of harsh online backlash toward BTS member Jin's edgy, heavy-eyeliner styling in the Gucci Primavera campaign photos. Sampled netizen comments call the look "boring" and mock the makeup harshly; genuine unfiltered fandom sentiment (not brand PR) with heavy SEA fan-base footprint since BTS ARMY is large across the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam and Thailand. One quoted fragment under 15 words: "never seen a more boring kpop idol than him."

items.title: [theqoo] BTS Jin x Gucci Primavera Campaign Photoshoot
items.summary: Aggregated Korean community-board (theqoo) reactions to the Primavera campaign photos, translated for international fan audiences; comments are split between criticism of the makeup ("handsome kids look best with no makeup") and defenders praising the experimental smokey styling as nostalgic of his debut era. Reflects organic, unmoderated community sentiment split roughly evenly rather than brand-controlled messaging.

items.title: 260825 Ningning for GUCCI Primavera Campaign (Preview)
items.summary: Aespa fan-community site posts and discusses preview images of member Ningning's individual portrait in the Gucci Primavera campaign, part of organic fandom amplification/tracking of the brand's Asian-ambassador roster. Reflects genuine K-pop fandom engagement volume (with sizeable SEA fan base) rather than brand-issued content.
